summary.text: Kent M. Williams is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 30, which covers Darlington, Dillon, Florence, Horry and Marion Counties, serving since 2005.
His official page lists his occupation as deputy county administrator.

paragraphs.text: Williams was born on September 15, 1960, in Marion.
His official page lists an A.S. from Florence-Darlington Technical College in 1981 and a B.S. from South Carolina State University in 1987.
He worked for the Clemson Extension Service from 1990 to 1999 and chaired the Marion County Board of Education from 1998 to 2004.
He has served in the Senate since 2005.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Banking and Insurance, Ethics, Finance, Fish, Game and Forestry, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Legislative Oversight.
He is a member and steward of St. James A.M.E. Church.
